Update

Update your box.

Plug in, press one button, wait. Nothing to install.

A computer with Chrome or Edge

Phones, Firefox and Safari can't do it.

A USB-C data cable

Charging-only cables look the same but won't connect.

This browser can't talk to the box. Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer and the button will be here. This page has to be opened over a secure connection for the button to work.

There's nothing new to put on it right now. When there is, the button turns up here on its own.

0%

  1. 1
    Plug it in

    Box to computer with the data cable. The screen should light up.

  2. 2
    Press Update my box

    Pick your box from the list. Not there? Unplug it, plug it back in, try again.

  3. 3
    Wait for the bar

    Don't unplug it while it fills. The box restarts by itself when it's done.

Taps still off after updating?Fix touch walks you through it. Its reset always works.
Your settings stay

Updating keeps them. Nothing else is stored on the box.

Nothing happens?

Try a different cable first, since most only charge. Then another USB port.
